meta.scope: Syria Batch 6 — Provincial densification (Damascus, Aleppo) and climate/drought densification under extremely constrained conditions.

candidates.title: Damascus economic and reconstruction framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from reconstruction and monitoring sources
candidates.description: Framing of Damascus as the capital and primary administrative, services and reconstruction focus. Significant physical damage in the wider metropolitan area; large share of post-transition investment interest and returnee inflows concentrated here.

candidates.title: Aleppo economic and industrial framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from reconstruction and monitoring sources
candidates.description: Framing of Aleppo as the principal northern industrial and commercial centre. Among the most heavily damaged governorates during the conflict; recovery of manufacturing, trade and urban services is a core reconstruction priority.

candidates.title: Drought and agricultural water-stress statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from FEWS NET and climate monitoring sources
candidates.description: Statistics and framing of drought conditions and water stress. Consecutive drought years have sharply reduced rainfed cereal output and groundwater; recent improved rainfall has supported recovery but cumulative damage to water resources and productive assets persists.
candidates.notes: High-centrality environmental constraint node linking agriculture and food security.

candidates.title: Syria provincial–climate densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from provincial and climate sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding Damascus and Aleppo provincial framings with drought/water-stress statistics into a coherent spatial and environmental residual layer under extremely constrained conditions.
